meta.disclaimer: Every duty, tax, preference, and freight figure in this file is a placeholder estimate for product design. It is not a customs tariff, not a carrier quote, and not legal or brokerage advice.
meta.dutyBasis: fob_product — duty is the rate times product cost (unit cost × quantity), unless a category sets dutyBasis to cif.
meta.taxBasis: Each destination tax object has a basis: cif_plus_duty (product + freight + insurance + duty), cif, or product.
meta.freightBasis: byOriginRegion[region][destination].perUnitUsd is placeholder ocean freight per piece for that category, already scaled. originOverrides may replace a region lane. Insurance is insuranceRateOfProduct × product cost.
meta.howToReplace: Drop researched numbers into this file without changing the keys. Update meta.dataStatus (for example to "researched"), meta.disclaimer, and meta.asOf. Add preferentialOverrides rows for origin/destination pairs that should not use MFN. Leave a pair out of preferentialOverrides to keep MFN. The app reads this file only — there is no second rate table in code.
